description: Not in the call format: roamgate-review's command lines, as the Python client (contract/assets/python/roamgate-review.py, run on SSH hosts) reads them and the Rust one (crates/roamgate-agent-client, run locally) must: per case its arguments, environment (over ROAMGATE_REVIEW_SOCKET=/run/roamgate-test/review.sock, COLUMNS=80 and HOME=/home/agent; the directory is /), standard input, the socket's reply (status and body, or unreachable; socket_exists false: no socket), and what the client did: each request (command, body as sent, timeout in seconds), the exit code and what it printed. Generated by running the Python client; read by crates/roamgate-agent-client/tests/vectors.rs.

                       {open,skill,list,get,add,reply,edit,delete,resolve,reopen,watch,summary,working,update,notify,place,worktree,workspace,groups,sessions,message,reviews,work,permission,questions,claude-start} ...

Talk to Roamgate's reviews, shown in its Changes view. Output is JSON.

positional arguments:
  {open,skill,list,get,add,reply,edit,delete,resolve,reopen,watch,summary,working,update,notify,place,worktree,workspace,groups,sessions,message,reviews,work,permission,questions,claude-start}
    open                open a review in Roamgate
    skill               print the instructions for agents
    list                reviews of this checkout (--all: every review here)
    get                 the review with all threads
    add                 start a thread
    reply               answer a thread
    edit                rewrite one of your comments
    delete              delete one of your comments
    resolve             resolve a thread
    reopen              reopen a resolved thread
    watch               wait for threads that need your answer or a handoff
    summary             the overall comment: read it (no text), or set it (kept only if the user has none)
    working             say you are working on the review
    update              say what changed
    notify              tell the user they need to act: a notification, and this agent in their list of what needs
                        them
    place               put a workspace under yours in Roamgate's Workspaces list (one you started work in), or in
                        --group
    worktree            create a Git worktree workspace, listed under yours in Roamgate, or in --group
    workspace           create a workspace in a directory, listed under yours in Roamgate, or in --group
    groups              the groups of Roamgate's Workspaces tree, as paths to give --group, and the one you are in
    sessions            the agent sessions Roamgate manages, on every connection, with the address to message each
    message             send another agent session a message (it is told it comes from you, not its user)
    reviews             the Reviews board: your requests' lanes and next steps, overrides, order (TOOL, then its
                        parameters as JSON)
    work                the Work board: work items by state, tags, owner and links (TOOL, then its parameters as JSON;
                        help lists them)
    permission          Claude Code PermissionRequest hook: ask in Roamgate, else the terminal
    questions           Claude Code PreToolUse hook for AskUserQuestion: answer in Roamgate, else the terminal
    claude-start        Claude Code SessionStart hook: conversation mode takes a claude started by hand, if Roamgate
                        is set so
